title: N9 Attendance System
summary: N9 Attendance = Modern attendance tracking + Smart leave management
details: N9 Attendance is a cross-platform attendance system built with Flutter, designed for companies that need secure, accurate, and real-time attendance tracking. Employees can punch in/out only inside the office network, apply for leaves, receive notifications, and view their complete attendance history — all from one powerful app.
Secure multi-step authentication with login, signup, OTP verification, forgot password, and biometric authentication (Face/Touch ID). Uses Flutter Secure Storage for token protection.
Punch In / Punch Out
Employees can punch in and punch out only when connected to the office WiFi/network. Real-time tracking of attendance, late logs, and working hours.

Apply for half-day or full-day leaves, track leave status, view approved/accured leaves, and get updates instantly. Includes holiday notifications and push alerts via OneSignal and local notifications.
Employees can view and edit their profile details, update password, enable biometric login, and manage settings.
Cross-Platform Support
Built with Flutter — runs seamlessly on Web, Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS, with consistent UI and offline-first capabilities.

title: Multi Cloud
summary: Multi Cloud is an all-in-one cloud management platform built with Flutter. It lets you monitor, manage, and control multiple cloud infrastructures — AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM Cloud, and Oracle Cloud — in a single unified dashboard.
details: Track server locations in real time, view machine health, toggle server states, and manage your entire multi-cloud architecture effortlessly with a smooth and modern UI.
Multi-Cloud Dashboard

A unified control center for AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM, and Oracle Cloud. Instantly check server uptime, performance, alerts, and system status. No more switching tabs — everything is finally in one place.
Powered by Flutter Maps, visually explore your server locations across the globe. Tap any server to view its status, logs, and metadata.
Server Control Panel
Need to update server status? Restart a machine? Mark a system as active or inactive? The app offers full control with secure role-based access.
Enterprise-grade authentication including login, biometric unlock, 2-step verification, OTP-based access, and encrypted Hive storage for local data. Safety is built into every layer.
Frontend is powered by Flutter + Riverpod + Go Router for smooth navigation flows. Backend uses Go and Node.js services working together, with PostgreSQL for reliable cloud data storage.

Clean hexagonal UI patterns, modern animations, custom typography (Lexend), and buttery-smooth transitions. Designed for maximum clarity and minimal cognitive load — perfect for enterprise monitoring.
Multi Cloud is built for DevOps teams, cloud engineers, administrators, and enterprises managing large-scale distributed infrastructure.
It's not just another monitoring tool — it’s your control tower for the entire cloud universe.

title: Sperium Lounge
summary: Sperium Lounge is a high-performance, Wi-Fi-based local restaurant ordering system designed specifically for lounges, cafés, and small food spots. No cloud, no external dependencies—everything runs locally within the restaurant’s network. Customers connect to the lounge Wi-Fi, scan a QR code, and instantly access the live digital menu through their browser, while the admin device hosts the entire backend (HTTP + WebSocket server), manages orders, and controls the real-time experience.
details: Built for speed, privacy, and a smooth customer experience, Sperium Lounge includes:
Fully offline local ordering — no internet required
Local HTTP server + Socket.IO real-time updates
QR-based menu access for customers
Live order tracking with instant staff updates
Cart, checkout, and responsive web UI
Hive-based local database for orders & menu

The admin app (Flutter) acts as the hub of the entire ecosystem. It hosts the server, manages the live menu, and receives customer orders in real time. Staff can update order statuses, modify the menu, and monitor activity—all through a smooth and responsive interface.

Customers simply join the lounge Wi-Fi and scan the QR code. The menu opens instantly in their browser—no installation needed. They browse, pick items, customize, and place orders with a clean and minimal web UI powered by HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (served locally).
Real-Time Order Flow (Socket.io)

Socket.IO handles instantaneous communication between customers and the admin device. When a customer submits an order, it appears on the admin dashboard immediately. As the staff prepares the order, status updates are pushed live back to the customer.
Local HTTP & WebSocket Server

Designed with a lounge-themed aesthetic—dark tones, smooth transitions, and crisp visual hierarchy. Both the admin and the customer interface focus on clarity, simplicity, and speed. Zero clutter. Zero lag.

Sparium Lounge isn’t just a food ordering system—it’s a complete, self-contained digital experience optimized for modern cafés and lounges. With real-time technology, offline reliability, and no cloud costs, it delivers a fully controlled and high-performance ordering workflow.

title: Dairy Management System
summary: The Dairy Management System is an end-to-end multi-platform solution built to modernize dairy operations for admins, farmers, customers, and superadmins. Designed for Windows and Android, this ecosystem manages everything from milk sales and exchanges to product listings, wallet balance, analytics, chat, notifications, and secure role-based control. With real-time updates powered by Firebase and OneSignal, the system streamlines daily dairy operations into a smooth, digital workflow.
details: Superadmin (Windows App)
The Superadmin panel provides complete control over the system. From managing admins to monitoring analytics, the dashboard gives a bird's-eye view of the whole dairy network.
Create, edit, and remove admin accounts
Update profile details and passwords
Analyze admin performance
Full administrative control
Admin (Windows & Android)
Admins manage farmers, customers, orders, products, categories, and financials. They act as the central controller of the entire system.
Manage farmers & customers
Create & update products and categories
Approve milk sales & item exchanges
Wallet management for all users
Real-time chat with farmers and customers
Farmer (Android App)
Farmers can sell milk, manage earnings, communicate with admins, and track their transactions from a simple and intuitive Android app.
Sell milk & manage sales
Use wallet balance to exchange goods
Chat directly with admin
View profile & transaction history
Customer (Android App)
Customers enjoy a personalized shopping experience with favorites, real-time order updates, and secure payments through eSewa.
Buy & favorite products
Integrated eSewa payments
Order tracking & history
Smart product recommendations (Cosine Similarity)
Real-Time Communication
All apps include secure real-time chat with encryption. Every message is instantly synced and protected using end-to-end encryption.
Secure encrypted chat system
Notifications & Alerts
The system uses Firebase & OneSignal to provide instant updates across all platforms—order updates, chat messages, payments, and more.
Recommendation Algorithm
The Customer app uses a Cosine Similarity model to recommend products based on a combination of pricing and category relevance, making shopping faster and more personalized.
Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Messaging)

With multiple apps, real-time communication, role-based dashboards, and intelligent recommendations, this Dairy Management System brings a modern digital workflow to traditional dairy businesses—efficient, scalable, and built for real-world use.

title: Quick DO
summary: Quick DO is a lightweight, offline-first task manager built with Flutter. It focuses on speed, reliability, and a clean UX — letting users create, organize, and track tasks without any backend. Data is stored locally using Hive, and the app follows a BLoC-based clean architecture for predictable state and maintainable code.
details: ➕ Add, edit, and delete tasks with an intuitive editor
✅ Mark tasks as completed or pending
📂 Categorize tasks (Work, Personal, Study, etc.) and use labels
🗓️ Set due dates, deadlines and schedule reminders
🔍 Search, filter and sort tasks by status, date, priority or category
🧩 Subtasks / checklists for breaking down larger tasks
💾 Offline-first persistence using Hive — works without internet
🔔 Local notifications for reminders and due tasks
🌙 Dark & Light theme support and Google Fonts for crisp typography
📊 Task statistics and completion trends using fl_chart
📱 Responsive layouts via flutter_screenutil for consistent UI
✨ Shimmer loading animations for smooth transitions
🏷️ Priority levels and color-coded categories
🗂️ Import / export todos (JSON/CSV) for backup and migration
🎤 Voice search to quickly find tasks hands-free
📦 Home screen widget (optional) to surface tasks quickly
Technical Highlights
Quick DO is implemented with maintainability and performance in mind:
BLoC (flutter_bloc) for predictable business logic & state
Equatable for efficient state comparisons
Hive + path_provider for fast local persistence
go_router for smooth declarative navigation
flutter_local_notifications for native reminders
fl_chart for attractive, interactive productivity charts
The UI prioritizes clarity: quick-add input, swipe actions for complete/delete, contextual filters, and a compact task card layout that surfaces due date, labels, and progress at-a-glance.
Deep-dive docs and feature pages:
Mark as Completed / Pending
Task Categories / Labels
Due Dates / Deadlines
Search / Filter Tasks
Statistics / Productivity Chart
Import / Export Todos

Quick DO is ideal for users who want a fast, private, and reliable task manager that doesn't rely on the cloud. It's perfect for personal productivity, students, and people who prefer local-first apps with robust offline features.

title: Fire Alert App
summary: Fire Alert System is a mobile + backend solution for rapid reporting, dispatching, and management of fire incidents. It connects citizens, dispatchers (middlemen), and fire brigades through a secure, realtime workflow — from incident reporting to resolution — and uses shortest-path algorithms to route responders efficiently.
details: A three-role system (User / Middleman / Admin) with:
Report creation (photos, video, GPS) from mobile users
Auto-assignment to nearest station using graph algorithms
Real-time notifications to responders and status updates to reporters
Admin dashboard for station & incident management, analytics, and logs
Quick incident reporting with GPS, photo/video upload, and severity input
Real-time status lifecycle: Pending → Assigned → En Route → Resolved
Nearest-station auto-assign (Dijkstra / A* support) and route visualization
Push notifications (OneSignal / FCM) for responders and users
Admin dashboard: map view, filters (severity, time), and analytics
Image upload + CDN (Cloudinary) integration for media handling
Recording restriction / DRM-style protections on sensitive streams
Offline support & local caching with Hive
Routing & dispatch rely on graph representations of the road network. Use-cases include nearest-station search (Dijkstra / BFS), route optimization (A*), and prioritized queues using heaps.
Suggested Database Schema
PostgreSQL (with PostGIS recommended) for geospatial queries and reliable transactional storage.
Core API Endpoints (examples)
REST endpoints (FastAPI) used by the Flutter app:
POST /api/auth/login — login & token
POST /api/alerts — submit a new alert (media + geo)
GET /api/alerts — list / filter alerts
GET /api/alerts/id — alert details
PATCH /api/alerts/id/status — update lifecycle
GET /api/firestations — list stations
POST /api/notifications/send — send targeted push
Frontend Tech & Packages
Flutter stack and packages used in the app:
dio + retrofit — HTTP client & API generation
flutter_dotenv — environment configuration
bloc / flutter_bloc / hydrated_bloc — state management & persistence
go_router — navigation
hive / hive_flutter — local caching
cached_network_image — media caching
flutter_screenutil, google_fonts, material 3 — responsive + modern UI
cloudinary (uploads) + loading_indicator + shimmer — UX polish
FastAPI — REST API & background tasks
PostgreSQL (+ PostGIS) — geospatial queries & storage
Redis (optional) — queueing and rate-limiting
OneSignal / FCM — push notifications
Cloudinary — media hosting
Docker — containerized deployments
Security & Operational Notes
Use bcrypt for password hashing; JWT for stateless auth
Validate & sanitize uploads; limit image/video sizes
Rate-limit alert creation to avoid spam / false alarms
Use HTTPS in production; never commit secrets to the repo
Use Sentry/Crashlytics for error monitoring and observability
Containerize backend (Docker) and deploy to cloud/container platform. Frontend builds distributed via Play Store / TestFlight or internal distribution. Automate migrations and CI for tests.
Next Steps / Roadmap
Automatic assignment using PostGIS nearest-neighbor queries
Heatmap & analytics dashboard for incident clustering
Advanced dispatcher UI with responder ETA & resource tracking
ML-based severity prediction from uploaded images (privacy-aware)

This Fire Alert App packs geospatial routing, realtime dispatching, and admin tooling to help reduce response times and coordinate resources effectively — designed for production readiness with FastAPI and PostgreSQL on the backend and a polished, Material 3 Flutter frontend.

title: LMS App
summary: A complete, production-ready Learning Management System (LMS) built with Flutter on the front end and a Node/Express + MongoDB backend. Designed for course creators, students, and institutions — the app supports video streaming, quizzes, purchases, progress tracking, content recommendations, certificate generation, and more.
details: Authentication & Access

Secure sign-in with Google Sign-In, email/password flow, and token-based sessions. Role-based access for students, instructors, and admins. DRM-style recording restrictions and playback controls prevent unauthorized screen recording or downloads for protected content.
Course Catalogue & Preview
Browse courses with rich metadata — syllabus, instructor bio, ratings, previews, and sample lessons. Users can preview a portion of any paid course before purchasing.
Video Streaming & Playback

Smooth adaptive video streaming with in-app player controls (seek, speed, captions). Playback includes protections (recording restriction, overlay watermarking) and resumable progress tracking so users can pick up where they left off.
Quizzes & Assessments
Create formative and summative quizzes with multiple question types: single/multiple choice, true/false, short answer. Auto-grading, manual review, time limits, and result analytics included.
Purchase & Monetization
In-app purchases for courses with secure checkout flows, promo codes, and price tiers. Purchase history and receipts are available in the user dashboard.
Progress Tracking & Streaks
Track course progress, lesson completion, daily learning streaks, and time-spent metrics. Visual dashboards help learners stay motivated.
Recommendations & Content Suggestion
Personalized course recommendations using engagement signals (completed lessons, quiz performance, categories). Suggested next-steps appear on the course detail and home screens.
Ratings, Reviews & Certificates

Students can rate and review courses. Upon successful completion, the system can generate downloadable/verifiable certificates (PDF) with course metadata and cryptographic signature options for validity.
Offline & Local Data
Local caching with SQLite stores progress, bookmarks, and downloaded preview assets. Works offline for viewing cached lessons and quizzes; syncs when connectivity is restored.
Frontend: Flutter + BLoC for predictable state management
Backend: Node.js + Express API with MongoDB for flexible schema
Video hosting/streaming: CDN or self-hosted HLS endpoints
Auth: Google Sign-In + JWT sessions
Storage: MongoDB for server data, SQLite for local cache
Payments: Integrate Stripe / platform-specific stores
Clean course cards, accessible player controls, keyboard navigation, subtitles support, and responsive layout for mobile/tablet/desktop.

LMS App is a full-featured learning platform ready for production: content creators can publish courses, admins manage catalog & monetization, and learners get a delightful, secure learning experience end-to-end.
